svg.title: What a plug-in registration consists of
svg.desc: A plug-in registration is four kinds of rows. The assembly row (table pluginassembly) holds the compiled DLL; optionally it belongs to a plug-in package (pluginpackage), a NuGet file that also carries dependent assemblies. Each class that implements IPlugin becomes a plug-in type row (plugintype). Each type has zero or more step rows (sdkmessageprocessingstep) that say when the class runs: message, table, stage, mode, order, filtering attributes, user and configuration. A step can own image rows (sdkmessageprocessingstepimage) and one secure configuration row that is not exported with solutions. Assemblies and steps are solution components and travel to Test and Production by solution import.
svg.text: A registration is data: four kinds of rows that tell Dataverse what to run and when
The DLL, stored in the database.
One row per class that implements
3. Step (the registration you create in the Plug-in Registration Tool)
WHEN: message + primary table + filtering attributes (Update)
HOW: synchronous or asynchronous, Run in User's Context, deployment Server
WITH: unsecure configuration (text stored on the step row)
Pre or post snapshot, alias, named columns.
NOT exported with a solution: re-enter per environment.
Assembly and steps (with images and unsecure configuration) are solution components. Add each step to CedarServiceCore; Test and Prod get them by import, never by PRT.
